entities.summary: Aurelio Casadei, known as Secondo Casadei (1 April 1906 – 19 November 1971) was an Italian musician, violinist, arranger, composer and bandleader. He is considered the most important exponent of liscio, an Italian style of dance and folk music born in Emilia-Romagna.
